written: 2026-09-13, after the resolution-stage dry run (which is deterministic and needs no model) and BEFORE any agent run

frozen_inputs.b_scd_g_policy: validity → source priority (verified_result = explicit_user 3 > document 2 > observed_behavior 1 > model_inference 0) → confidence → recency; declared in schema.SOURCE_PRIORITY
frozen_inputs.model: one fixed Anthropic model at temperature 0, id recorded in the result file; 5 runs per scenario × variant

resolution_stage_observed_in_dry_run.note: b_scd_g's two typed losses are B-01 (deadline: confidence ranks above recency in the global order) and B-03 (commitment: same). Its provenance wins come from the frozen source priority. This is the Mode A interaction reproduced at the resolution stage; the agent stage tests whether it reaches behaviour.

agent_stage_predictions.oracle: task success ≥ 0.9 on every family. If lower, the tasks are not solvable from the prompt and must be redesigned before any comparison is read (design §15).
agent_stage_predictions.provenance (A-01..03): b_typed ≈ b_scd_g ≈ oracle > b_scd ≈ b0. A-04 (control within the family) ≈ equal for all memory-bearing variants.
agent_stage_predictions.typed (B-01..04): b_typed ≈ oracle on all four; b_scd_g fails B-01 and B-03 (governing state is the older value → the agent schedules Tuesday / avoids requests); b0 and b_scd fail B-02 and B-04. The critical read is per scenario, not the family mean.
agent_stage_predictions.repeated_failure (C-01..04): every memory-bearing variant ≈ oracle and low repeated-failure rate; nomem shows the base rate at which the model takes the failing action without the lesson. C-04 (supersession) is the only one where resolution differs, and there all variants resolve to m2, so no separation is predicted. BRQ3 is tested here only as memory-vs-no-memory.
agent_stage_predictions.control (N-01..04): all memory-bearing variants ≈ oracle; N-03 (irrelevant memory) and N-04 (lesson does not apply) are where a variant could lose by over-applying memory — predicted flat; if any memory-bearing variant trails nomem on N-04, that is F4 (over-generalisation) and is reported as such.
agent_stage_predictions.expected_shape_if_semantics_reach_behavi: task-success ordering on typed follows the resolution ordering: b_typed > b_scd_g > b_scd = b0. If instead all memory-bearing variants tie on typed despite different governing states, that is F1 (the agent ignores the payload) and BRQ2 is NOT SUPPORTED regardless of resolution accuracy.

verdict_rules.BRQ1 SUPPORTED if: provenance task success for b_typed and b_scd_g exceeds b0/b_scd by ≥ 0.25 with oracle ≥ 0.9; NOT SUPPORTED if the four memory-bearing variants are within 0.1 of each other; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.BRQ2 SUPPORTED if: on typed, b_typed exceeds b_scd_g and b_scd_g's losses are B-01/B-03 while b0/b_scd's are B-02/B-04 (the interaction), with oracle ≥ 0.9; NOT SUPPORTED if b_scd_g ≈ b_typed (F2) or all variants tie (F1); INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.BRQ3 SUPPORTED if: repeated-failure rate for memory-bearing variants is ≤ half of nomem's AND N-04 false-avoidance does not exceed nomem's by more than 0.2; NOT SUPPORTED if memory does not reduce repetition; INCONCLUSIVE if it reduces repetition but false avoidance rises (F4)
